'''Nexus Ortai''' was a [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located at the intersection of two [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]]. It was considered a peaceful world.

==History==
A [[Battle of Nexus Ortai|battle]] took place during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between forces of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], both vying for control of its strategic position.

After the loss of Nexus Ortai, [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] noted that it was nearly the twenty-fourth world to fall in the region.

Nexus Ortai was conquered by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] during their [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invasion of the galaxy]].<ref name="TEA" />
